figures.caption: Dam break front position X(T) comparison: reference (Lethe digitisation) vs simulation at a=40 and a=80 (baseline velocity_shift forcing). Shows systematic underprediction at T=2 and T=2.96.
Relative error vs dimensionless time T for baseline (a=40, a=80) and Guo forcing (G=5.0, τ=0.8). Only T=1 at a=80 passes 3% threshold; T=2 and T=2.96 systematically fail.
Parameter space showing opposite G dependencies: decreasing G improves T=2.96 error but worsens T=1 error, making single-parameter tuning infeasible.
